context:
Goal: a builder never weakens a test, and work does not park or get merged by hand to get round the guard.
Problem (rule): the builder-diff guard counts main's own test changes, brought in by a main merge, as the builder's test edits, so PRs park and orchestrators merge by hand. Changing what the guard counts changes a recorded rule, so it needs your word.
Based on (measured): 2 hand merges today (1a444eb96 on #1932; #2194 at 11:59 CST), 8 PRs parked on #1521, 1 false alarm on the word sed. Catches of a real test weakening: unmeasured.
Based on (read): rule roles-one-role-per-agent and roles-each-layer-proves-once: a test-author writes the red tests, and the builder changes product code.
Departs from: the builder-diff guard on main (counts main's test changes against the builder) — counts only the builder's own test edits.
Meanwhile: the 8 PRs stay parked on #1521.

options.gain: Builders still never write test content, main's own test changes pass, the 8 parked PRs move, and hand merges stop. Conflicts inside test files still go to a test-author (#1521).
options.label: Keep the rule; measure against main after the merge
options.lose: One guard change, with up to 3 review rounds.

options.gain: Fewest steps; no guard to maintain.
options.label: Drop the rule; the reviewer checks test edits
options.lose: No red-first proof: a builder could weaken a test and only a reviewer's read would catch it.

options.label: Keep the guard as it is
options.lose: PRs keep parking, and hand merges go on (2 today).

reply: 12:19 CST Nov 8: a, routed to lane builder-diff-merge-commit (session_013NEJKzVTWMbokJ3KFanBBC); home: decision builders-cannot-edit-tests. Builders still never write test content; the guard measures their test edits against main after the merge, so main's own test changes pass. Conflicts inside test files still go to a test-author (#1521).
title: Should the builder-test guard count only the builder's own test edits, not main's?
